item.description:
A menu bar that does more: provider cards, a waiting dot, your choice of width, order and click. Plus Spanish, Higgsfield, and rings ordered by what is about to expire.

  • Provider cards in the menu, with a Detail switch per card.
  • Waiting and done in the menu bar: a red dot when an agent waits for you, a blink when it finishes, and a deeper working pulse.
  • The menu bar, your way: show what is left, choose how much each reading prints, sort by what is left, and pick what a click does.
  • Order rings by burn deficit: quota that would expire unused comes first.
  • Español on the Mac and on Windows, and a Higgsfield ring.
  • Antigravity reads the quota group you chose, Ollama's cloud usage, OpenCode 2.x keys, whole tokens per second under local rings, and even bar thickness.
  • Windows: Claude accounts and an optional taskbar display, Command Code, Qoder, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode sessions, and an optional usage pace line.
